title: Sealing of the Holy Spirit
definition: Sealing of the Holy Spirit is God's mark of ownership, security, and promised inheritance given to believers.
summary: The Spirit seals believers as God's possession and guarantee of future inheritance.
christFocus: Jesus secures salvation, and the Spirit seals believers in Him until the day of redemption.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The sealing of the Spirit means believers belong to God. The Spirit is the mark of ownership and the guarantee of the inheritance promised in Christ.

This seal gives assurance without encouraging carelessness. The same passage that speaks of being sealed also warns believers not to grieve the Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many believers fear that weakness will cause God to abandon them. This doctrine matters because it points to God's ownership and preserving grace.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Take comfort that you belong to God in Christ. Let the Spirit's seal move you toward holiness, gratitude, and assurance.
